The '''Mirage Flats''' is located east of [[Dustbelch Grotto]] in the [[Badlands]]. It is populated primarily by [[Giant Buzzard]]s, [[Ridge Stalker Patriarch]]s, and [[Rabid Crag Coyote]]s.
